name: Evanston (United States)
description: Green field with a diagonal yellow band and a blue fly, charged with a white eight-pointed star: a stylised aerial view of the city with its trees, sand beach and Lake Michigan, the star for the light of the Grosse Point Lighthouse.
history: Evanston is a city in Cook County, Illinois. The flag was adopted in 2024 (the winning design of a city contest by a seven-year-old, Bernie Allen-Harrah, unveiled at a city council meeting in May 2024, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: diagonal band for the sand beach
star for the Grosse Point Lighthouse
